expert_learning.title: Spend experiment budgets on more distinct settings
expert_learning.faithful_paraphrase: Karpathy explains that random search can explore consequential settings more efficiently than a rigid grid when a model is sensitive to only some settings.
expert_learning.editorial_application: In a bounded AI experiment, compare configurations within safe predefined ranges against the same evaluation set, instead of wasting repeated trials on settings with little effect. The nine-trial example is editorial.
expert_learning.report_summary: Karpathy explains that random search can explore consequential settings more efficiently than a rigid grid when a model is sensitive to only some settings. The nine-trial example is editorial, and this is not a claim of universal superiority over adaptive search.
expert_learning.caveat: This is an evergreen experimental-design intuition, not a universal claim that random search beats modern adaptive methods. Distinct from inspecting inputs or validating a tiny pipeline.
